RESOLUTION NO.
BOARD IN THE SUBMISSION OF AN APPLICATION FOR FEDERAL
ASSISTANCE TO THE FEDERAL AVIATION ADMINISTRATION FOR
DESIGN AND BIDDING SERVICES FOR THE RECONSTRUCT RUNWAY
9/27(PHASEIII)PROJECT.""
WHEREAS, the Cheyenne Regional Airport Board desires to participate in the Federal
Aviation Administration grant program to assist in funding ^Design and Bidding Services for the
Reconstruct Runway 9/27(Phase I1) Project”(*"Project"); and
WHEREAS, the Governing Body recognizes that reconstruction of the runway will improve
aviation infrastructure; and
WHEREAS, the Cheyenne Regional Airport Board proposes to file an application with the
Federal Aviation Administration for grant funding in the amount of Seven Hundred Fifty-Five
Thousand Dollars ($755,000.00) to fund the Project; and
WHEREAS, the Cheyenne Regional Airport Board will match the requested Federal
Aviation Administration grant application through a combination of funding already secured and
in place for the Project from the FAA ($660,940.00), WyDOT Aeronautics ($26,430.00), Air
National Guard ($50,000.00), and Cheyenne Regional Airport ($17,630.00).
NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE GOVERNING BODY OF THE CITY
OF CHEYENNE, WYOMING, that the City of Cheyenne supports the grant application to be
funds in the amount of Seven Hundred Fifty-Five Thousand Dollars ($755,000.00) to be used for
Design and Bidding Services for the Reconstruct Runway 9/27 (Phase II) Project.
BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that if the grant application described in this Resolution is
approved, the Mayor and City Clerk are authorized to sign therelated grant agreement and other
associated documents which may reasonably be required by the Federal Aviation Administration
to finalize the grant transaction.
